module: Small 2D orientation gizmo drawn in a corner of the editor view (ImGui, foreground draw list) for Easy Object Select: three axes X (red), Y (green), Z (blue) projected according to the camera orientation (core_camera.getQuat), with solid labeled positive tips and darker negative tips. Displays "W" (world) or "L" (local) depending on whether a local object is given.

draw.desc: Draws the gizmo. If localObjectId designates an existing object, the axes follow its transform matrix (L mode), otherwise the world axes (W mode). The tips are sorted by depth.

rightOffset.desc: Offset from the right edge of the scene view, in pixels before uiscale (default 64).

topOffset.desc: Offset from the top, in pixels before uiscale (default 64).

localObjectId.desc: ID of an object whose local axes are displayed.
